items.label: Fabric Description
items.value: Outdoor Ventures Women's Waterproof Rain Jackets made of 100% high quality polyester 315T /50D*50D fabric with TPU waterproof transparent film, Waterproof Rating:10000mm, Breathability rating:10000g/m2/24hr.The stitches are fully seam-sealed and welded with TPU membrane.There is no need to worry about rain seeping through the inner garment.

items.label: Packable & Portable
items.value: Outdoor Ventures Lightweight Rain Jacket has a packable carry bag on the left side pocket, making it easy to pack into a handbag, travel bag, suitcase or car. It is a great companion for your traveling. There are two zippered pockets on the outside of the jacket, put your cell phone, keys, cards, etc. not easily lost.

items.label: Stylish Design
items.value: Outdoor Ventures Long Rain coats as an elastic drawstring around the waist, which can be adjusted to your liking to show off your curves.The curved hem of this jacket is beautifully designed to be worn as a trench coat.

items: Windproof & Warmth：Outdoor Ventures Hiking Rain Jacket has an adjustable drawstring on the hood to keep your hair and ears protected. The elasticized cuffs are not only comfortable, but also keep out the wind and rain.

items.label: Occasion
items.value: Outdoor Ventures Women's Raincoat only suitable for travel, cycling, hiking, mountaineering, fishing, camping, golf and other outdoor activities, but also can be used as a daily jacket to match.
